ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The attached circuit diagram shows an infinite-capacity source marked S=∞ and a 6.3 kV bus. From this bus, identical line branches are drawn in parallel toward the right-side fault point f. Each branch is labeled with impedance 0.050+j0.797 Ω. The right side indicates a three-phase short-circuit location f. Reasoning: Since the 6.3 kV bus voltage remains unchanged, each parallel line connected to the fault is supplied by the same line-to-line voltage 6.3 kV. For one line, |Z|=sqrt(0.050^2+0.797^2)=0.7986 Ω. The one-line three-phase symmetrical RMS short-circuit current is I=6.3 kV/(sqrt(3)*0.7986 Ω)=4.55 kA. Using the standard short-circuit surge/impact multiplier about 2.55, the one-line surge current is i_sh=2.55*4.55=11.6 kA. If n identical lines are laid in parallel, the surge currents add, so total surge current is about 11.6n kA. Requiring 11.6n≤20 gives n≤1.72. Therefore the maximum integer number of such parallel lines is 1.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit shown: an infinite-capacity 6.3 kV source feeds identical line impedances labeled 0.050+j0.797 Ω in parallel toward a three-phase short-circuit point f. From the text, take the surge-current limit as 20 kA. Compute the required minimum Thevenin/equivalent impedance magnitude that would keep the three-phase surge current at or below 20 kA after applying the standard surge coefficient. Then compare this minimum impedance with the equivalent impedance of n identical parallel lines, Z_eq=(0.050+j0.797)/n. Test integer n values or solve the inequality for n; n=2 makes the impedance too small and the surge current too high, while n=1 satisfies the limit, so the maximum is 1.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧是无限大容量电源，标注 S=∞，母线电压标注为 6.3 kV。电源通过若干条相同线路接到右侧短路点 f；图中每条线路旁标注的阻抗均为 0.050+j0.797 Ω，线路之间为并联关系，右侧在 f 点发生三相短路。

再推理：每条线路阻抗为 Z=0.050+j0.797 Ω，其幅值为 |Z|=sqrt(0.050^2+0.797^2)≈0.7986 Ω。若有 n 条相同线路并联，则等效阻抗为 Z_eq=Z/n，幅值 |Z_eq|=0.7986/n Ω。三相短路电流周期分量为 I=U/(sqrt(3)|Z_eq|)。短路冲击电流按标准冲击系数取 i_sh=2.55I，因此要求 2.55×6.3 kV/(sqrt(3)|Z_eq|)≤20 kA。由此得 |Z_eq|≥2.55×6300/(sqrt(3)×20000)≈0.464 Ω。代入 |Z_eq|=0.7986/n，得 0.7986/n≥0.464，即 n≤1.72。n 必须为整数，所以最大 n=1。检验 n=2 时等效阻抗约 0.399 Ω，冲击电流会超过 20 kA；n=1 时满足限制。
